description: Defines classes and methods for managing asynchronous in-flight I/O operations in disk cache, including BackgroundIO and InFlightIO classes with thread synchronization and callback handling.

classes.name: BackgroundIO
classes.description: Represents a single asynchronous IO operation, with reference counting, signaling, and cancellation capabilities.

classes.name: InFlightIO
classes.description: Manages multiple asynchronous IO operations, handling posting, completion, callbacks, and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: OnIOSignalled
methods.description: Signals that the IO operation has completed.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Returns the result of the IO operation.

methods.name: io_completed
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the waitable event signaling IO completion.

methods.name: NotifyController
methods.description: Notifies the controller that the IO operation has finished.

methods.name: ClearController
methods.description: Clears the reference to the controller.

methods.name: InFlightIO
methods.description: Constructor for managing in-flight IO operations.

methods.name: WaitForPendingIO
methods.description: Blocks until all tracked IO operations are complete.

methods.name: DropPendingIO
methods.description: Drops all pending IO operations without waiting.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of an IO operation.

methods.name: InvokeCallback
methods.description: Invokes the user callback after IO completion.

methods.name: OnOperationComplete
methods.description: Pure virtual; called when an IO operation completes.

methods.name: OnOperationPosted
methods.description: Signals that an IO operation has been posted.
